name: mcp-ai-wpoos/pro-addon
description: Pro addon dependencies for NV Digital Open Operator System (oOS)

suggest.mpdf/mpdf: Alternative PDF library with better HTML/CSS support (requires mb_string extension)
suggest.setasign/fpdi: PDF manipulation library for merging and modifying PDFs
suggest.intervention/image: Alternative image manipulation library (fallback when Imagick extension not available)
